chandra: heads-up — after landing rope_rescale_v1 in the quant packing for mag13b-v3.int4pack, long-window rerank/fill metrics drop on the "long-horizon" eval. reproducer attached.

tom: drop magnitude?
chandra: ~2.7% AUC on rerank, embeddings cosine drops ~0.018 for positions >6144. KV checksum mismatch surface around token 6144..6152.
mei: is this only int4pack, or do int8 and float16 show it?
chandra: only int4pack + the new rescale. int8/float16 baselines stable.
raj: can you paste the run cmd?
chandra: sure:
```
./run_long_horizon --model mag13b-v3.int4pack --seq 12288 --prefill 8192 --batch 2 --kv compact --seed 7 --dump-kv=kv_dump.bin
```
chandra: excerpt from kv dump diffs (expected vs actual hashes):
```
[6139] expected=0x9a12 got=0x9a12
[6144] expected=0x4f3b got=0x8d2c   <-- first divergence
[6148] expected=0xb1a0 got=0x2c01
```
liz: interesting. 6144 is a multiple of our tile size (256*24). Did rope_rescale change frequency interpolation or the way we pack rotary keys?
mei: rope_rescale_v1 scales sin/cos by a per-channel multiplier to counteract quant shrink, which we compute during packing. maybe quantized multiplier gets rounded differently for higher offsets.

chandra: added debug kernel logs. snippet: 
```
[6136] kernel_variant=kv_compact_a  base_ptr=0x7f4a align=64
[6144] kernel_variant=kv_compact_b  base_ptr=0x7f4a align=48
[6145] kernel_variant=kv_compact_b  base_ptr=0x7f4a align=48
```
chandra: kernel switch at exactly 6144 and alignment drops to 48 (not 64). reading unaligned lanes in v_b path could explain corruption.

tom: why would alignment change mid-run? packing shouldn't mutate base_ptr at runtime. maybe packing produced a pointer that only becomes misaligned after a prefill stride wraps.
raj: also check that the rescale multipliers are not stored in a compacted int16 array with different stride when the sequence crosses 6144. a stride overflow could cause reading from a neighbor buffer.
mei: good idea. I dumped the multiplier arrays before/after packing; content looks contiguous but values at indices >=6144 show quantized saturation in a small subset of channels (values pegged to 127). that looks wrong.

eval-bot: eval queued: long-horizon-rerank/mag13b-v3.int4pack (seq=12288,prefill=8192)
bench-bot: bench run started: long-horizon-fill (batch=2)

chandra: quick experiment: forcible fallback to kv_compact_a for entire run -> metrics return to baseline (AUC within 0.4%).
liz: hotpatch proves witness. will add assert in kernel init to verify base_ptr % 16 == 0 and fail fast if not. also revert rescale placement to ensure the multiplier buffer aligns to 64 bytes.
raj: i'll add unit test that performs packing with a synthetic multiplier distribution and asserts no saturation for indices up to 16384.
tom: we should also add a small CI smoke with seq ~7000 that triggers the kernel path switch so this doesn't regress silently.
mei: root cause hypothesis: quant packing + rope_rescale_v1 created a tight-packed multiplier buffer; prefill stride arithmetic wrapped at 6144 causing the kernel selector to pick v_b while reading from an unaligned address -> corrupted lanes.
chandra: next steps:
- liz: PR to add alignment checks + safe fallback to v_a if misaligned (urgent)
- mei: patch packer to pad multiplier buffer to 64B and fix quant rounding at high indices
- raj: unit test for multiplier saturation + add synthetic long-smoke to CI
- tom: add kernel selector guards and extra logging on path transitions

bench-bot: forced-fallback run: fillrate baseline matched (delta < 0.5%).
eval-bot: sanity: rerank_auc(gold)=0.912 curr=0.908 delta=-0.004.

chandra: thanks team. I'll open an issue linking PRs and attach the kv_dump + multiplier dumps. adding tags: needs-urgent, quant, kv, rope. :white_check_mark:
